snippet.title: Zombie Run HD - Universal - HD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Zombie Run HD by RetroStyle Games

HAVE FUN OR DIE TRYING!
Shamble up and take a look at the most exciting undying runner at the AppStore!

Help awaken Zombies to escape from The Rusty Mug, a bar accidentally built atop an old cemetery.

Featuring:
★ Brainless controls!
★ 8 Unique characters!
★ Jaw-dropping graphics!
★ Lot of fun!

And remember: zombies! They are cool.

Universal Binary - compatible with iPod 3, iPod 4, iPhone 3GS, iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPad 1, iPad 2, iPad 3.


★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
Please, Rate and Comment to support development.

iTunes Store Page:

http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/zombie-run-hd/id535003306?mt=8

Homepage:

http://retrostylegames.com/contact/
